name: Historic Centre of Avignon: Papal Palace, Episcopal Ensemble and Avignon Bridge
description: For much of the 14th century, Avignon in southern France was the home of the popes, and their fortress-like Palais des Papes still towers over the city on the Rhône. Inside, its severe stone walls hide rich frescoes, while medieval ramparts encircle the old town and the broken arches of the Pont d'Avignon reach partway into the river. The Petit Palais and Romanesque cathedral complete the hilltop group.
